# MarketingPro

> MarketingPro is a remote-first digital marketing agency working with businesses across Italy, Europe and the United States. We run marketing that brings in real customers, not just leads: we generate the leads, call and qualify them ourselves, and hand over people who are ready to buy or ask for a quote.

MarketingPro works with businesses across Italy, Europe and the United States, in English, Italian, Spanish and Albanian. The team covers the full picture, from social media and paid advertising to websites, SEO, sales funnels, photo and video, 3D renders and print catalogues. The angle that runs through everything is qualification: every lead is contacted and filtered before it reaches the client, so sales teams spend their time on people who actually want to talk business.

- Business name: MarketingPro (Digital Marketing Agency)
- Markets: Italy · Europe · United States (remote-first)
- Contact: commerciale@marketingpro-agency.com · +355 694702405 (also WhatsApp)
- Languages spoken by the team: English, Italian, Spanish, Albanian
- Pricing: quoted per project, no published rate card. Ask and we reply within one business day.

## Services

Each service has its own page. The guide linked beside it is the long,
non-commercial explanation of the same subject.

- [Social Media Management That Brings In Customers](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-social-media): We run your social channels so followers turn into paying customers. Content, community, and every lead called and qualified before it reaches you. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-social-media
- [Ad Campaigns Where Every Lead Is Qualified](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-advertising): Targeted Meta and Google campaigns with every lead called and qualified before we hand it over. Seven campaigns, 6,150 leads, an average of 1.87 euro each. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-advertising
- [A Website That Sells, Not Just One That Looks Good](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-website): Websites built to turn visitors into enquiries, not just to look good. Fast, responsive, and structured so both search engines and buyers can find you. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-website
- [SEO That Keeps Working After You Stop Paying](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-seo): SEO that lifts you up the results and keeps you there. Keyword research, content, technical fixes and authority, measured in enquiries not rankings. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-seo
- [A Funnel That Closes, Not Just One That Collects](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-sales-funnel): A mapped route from a stranger seeing your ad to a signed contract, with the leaks found and closed and every lead qualified before it reaches your team. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-sales-funnel
- [Editing That Makes Your Brand Look Its Best](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-photo-video): Professional editing that makes your brand look its best. Colour, sound and consistency across every image and clip you put in front of a buyer. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-photo-video
- [Sell the Vision Before It Is Built](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-renders): Photorealistic 3D renders that let clients picture the finished result and say yes sooner, for products, spaces and concepts that do not exist yet. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-renders
- [Catalogues That Sell, Not Spreadsheets With Pictures](https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/services-catalogues): Catalogues that sell rather than list. Concept, copywriting and design handled end to end, for print, digital or both, with room for every product. Guide: https://www.marketingpro-agency.com/blog-catalogues

## Published results

The Meta results published on our services page are real campaign exports, not illustrations. Across those seven campaigns: 6,150 leads from 1,084,529 people reached, at a blended cost of 1.87 euro per lead, with individual campaigns landing between 1.47 and 2.30 euro. Total ad spend was 11,480.98 euro.
